blocks.html: Steel fiber-reinforced concrete used in beams shall be subject to the requirements of ACI 318, Section 26.12.5. The required testing and inspection of steel fiber-reinforced concrete shall be deemed a special inspection. Steel fibers shall not be used in place of required reinforcing bars.
